text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And I mean it! I'll do anything! Just<n>say the word,
Big G!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Intriguing. So that's the soma you<n>offer me this
day, Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, for your birthday present, I<n>wanted to give
you the coolest thing<n>in the world. I racked my brain
for<n>days about it...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Then I realized! It wouldn't matter<n>what it was,
'cause Big G would still<n>be even cooler! So...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I thought I'd just ask you, the coolestperson ever, what you want!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh, and you said you'd doanything? There is only one thing Idesire...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Rise to the peak of aesthetics<n>yourself, Vodka!
Have the conviction<n>to become the coolest in the
world<n>and embrace your destiny!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Your momentous running, you see, is<n>the aqua vitae
that will stream life into<n>my psyche—and you will
surpass me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wow, even your wishlist is cooler<n>than I can
handle! But I won't break a<n>promise to the greatest
there is! I'll<n>fulfill my destiny!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But that's gonna take me a while to<n>do... So give
me something I can do<n>today!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I guess you're right... Okay,<n>make an appetizer
and some tea, and<n>we'll celebrate with that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Food and tea?! Just that's<n>okay? 'Cause
you can choose<n>anything, really!
